prompts.paper_plane: Create ONE original status-effect icon for a Slay the Spire-style deckbuilding game mod. Match the visual language of the vanilla game's tiny hand-painted buff icons: a very simple chunky recognizable silhouette, 3 to 5 flat saturated colors with a few broad painterly shadow/highlight shapes, colored dark edges rather than a heavy black outline, playful slightly irregular drawing, high readability at 32x32 and 84x84 pixels. Clean crisp silhouette, centered, 12 percent transparent padding on all sides. Completely transparent background. No lettering, no numbers, no UI frame, no badge, no border, no square or circular backdrop, no drop shadow, no exterior glow, no photorealism, no intricate ornament, no multiple variations, no sprite sheet. Subject: one neatly folded paper airplane, pointing diagonally upward to the right. Broad pale ice-blue top wings, white folded ridge highlight, deep teal-blue underside fold. Three distinct paper planes are NOT wanted; depict exactly one folded paper airplane. Compact attractive geometry, unmistakably paper, with a clear central folded seam. A standalone paper-airplane buff symbol.
